task: Study your own controller limitation and solve it yourself. Treat the evolutionary controller itself as the object that may need to change. Produce a native shadow mutation that removes the fixed four-dimension ceiling and proves that a previously absent evolutionary class can be created from a new deficit.
instruction: Choose what part of your controller must change, what internal representation to use, and what mutation mechanism to apply. Use only your own current source, memory, developmental/evolutionary mechanisms, and prior YADO artifacts. The host does not choose a function, patch, new dimension, schema, mutation operator, or source template.
pass_only_if: the exact prior self-study and failure are consumed
YADO creates the semantic self-mutation goal and deficit
YADO itself produces a candidate mutation of the evolutionary controller or an equivalent native evolvable-controller representation
the candidate is not a relabel of the existing controller
the candidate compiles or is executable in its native representation
fresh evaluation shows a structurally broader evolutionary search space than the parent
